source_name.description: The iSCSI qualified source name for this client. If left empty, it is derived from the hostname.

server_address.description: Name and port of the iSNS server (e.g., host, host:port, IP:port, or SLP:).

security.description: Authentication enable/disable. Set to 1 to enforce signed messages.

auth_key_file.description: Path to the client's private DSA key file (PEM encoded).

server_key_file.description: Path to the server's public DSA key file (PEM encoded).
